name: INLocation
title: India Location Profile
description: Country-layer profile for Location under Indian jurisdiction. Authored by this project, NOT an official NRCES/ABDM-published profile — the identifier-system URI below is a project-chosen placeholder; swap in the real NRCES/ABDM canonical URL if/when integrating with India's official ABDM FHIR Implementation Guide. Requires a physical address with state and a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code on every Location, plus an optional Health Facility Registry (HFR) identifier (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) for Locations that are themselves a registered physical healthcare facility — mirrors in-organization's own hfr-id slice, but placed here instead since ABDM's Health Facility Registry registers physical premises, which map to Location, not the legal provider entity (Organization). Extensions are deliberately disallowed (Location.extension narrowed to max=0 below) since none are defined yet — same governance decision as in-organization.
_comment_element_order: Same two validator-version quirks documented in country_in.json for Organization (org.hl7.fhir.validation 6.5.18) apply here too: (1) within the hfr-id slice, .use must be listed BEFORE .system (the slicing discriminator's own target sub-element), or the discriminator fails to resolve. (2) the Location.extension max=0 constraint must be listed BEFORE the Location.identifier slicing block, not after, or the hfr-id required/format checks silently stop being enforced. Neither failure is visible at /profiles registration time, only at /validate. Not a real StructureDefinition field — a note for whoever edits this file next.

element.comment: No custom extensions are defined for this profile yet, so max is narrowed to 0 — same reasoning and same validator-ordering requirement (must stay BEFORE the Location.identifier block below) as Organization's own in-organization profile — see _comment_element_order above.

Base R4 Location.address is 0..1 — legally narrowed to 1..1 here. A physical address is required for any Location registered under this profile; a Location with no address at all can't carry a PIN code or state, both required below.
Required for Indian facility addresses — used for state-level regulatory/administrative classification (e.g. state health department reporting), not enforced at the base R4 layer.

constraint.human: postalCode must be a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code (first digit 1-9, no leading zero).

slicing.description: Slices Location.identifier by system to separately track the India-specific HFR registry identifier alongside any other identifiers a location may carry — 'open' so unrelated identifiers (internal references, etc.) are still allowed.

element.comment: 0..1 at this generic country layer since not every Location using this profile is itself a registered physical healthcare facility (e.g. a ward or room sub-Location under a registered site). A tenant-layer (organization-scope) profile for an actual registered site Location would tighten this to 1..1 — narrowing an already-allowed 0..1 down to 1..1 is a legal profile-of-a-profile per the narrowing rule (see docs/structure-definitions/05-cardinality-and-multiplicity.md).

constraint.human: HFR ID identifier's use must be 'official' or 'temp'.
